What is an online RSVP?

An online RSVP lets guests answer an invitation from a web page instead of by phone, text or mail. On MyInviteQR guests tap the RSVP button, choose yes, no or maybe, enter how many people are coming and can leave a message.

For hosts, it replaces scattered replies with a live guest list. Filter by confirmed, pending, declined, maybe, opened or not opened, and export the list to CSV for your caterer or venue.

Free to design and preview. Pay once only when you publish.

Tips for getting more RSVPs

  • Put the RSVP button at the top of your invitation, not only at the bottom.
  • Set a clear reply-by date.
  • Send a friendly reminder to guests who opened the invitation but have not replied.
  • Ask for party size so you know the true headcount.
  • Use individual links so each guest is recognized automatically (Premium).

RSVP wording that gets replies

Short prompts that make it easy for guests to respond.

Please confirm your attendance and the size of your party.

Online RSVP invitation questions

How does online RSVP work?

Guests open your invitation link, tap the RSVP button and answer yes, no or maybe with their party size. You see the response in your dashboard right away.

Do guests need an account to RSVP?

No. They only need the link or QR code.

Can I close RSVPs after a deadline?

You control your invitation and can update the details or the reply-by date at any time.

Can I download my guest list?

Yes. Export your guests and their responses to CSV whenever you need to.

Can guests change their answer?

Guests can open the invitation again and update their response.

Can I see who has not replied?

Yes. Use the Pending and Not opened filters in your guest list.
